mapper.select: SELECT t.*, c.category_name, cu.real_name AS creator_name, au.real_name AS assignee_name FROM ticket t LEFT JOIN ticket_category c ON c.id = t.category_id LEFT JOIN `user` cu ON cu.id = t.creator_id LEFT JOIN `user` au ON au.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM ticket WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT ticket_no FROM ticket WHERE ticket_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') ORDER BY ticket_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket ( ticket_no, title, content, category_id, creator_id, assignee_id, priority, status, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, handle_result, finish_time, close_time, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{ticketNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{categoryId}, #{creatorId}, #{assigneeId}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{handleResult}, #{finishTime}, #{closeTime}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update:
UPDATE ticket
title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category_id = #{categoryId}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, contact_email = #{contactEmail}, handle_result = #{handleResult}, finish_time = #{finishTime}, close_time = #{closeTime}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = #{status}
SELECT COALESCE(c.category_name, '未分类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ticket t LEFT JOIN ticket_category c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT u.id AS handlerId, u.real_name AS handlerName, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ticket t INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.assignee_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.id, u.real_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10
